sanskrit: e̱ṣa sya bhā̱nur ud i̍yarti yu̱jyate̱ ratha̱ḥ pari̍jmā di̱vo a̱sya sāna̍vi | pṛ̱kṣāso̍ asmin mithu̱nā adhi̱ trayo̱ dṛti̍s tu̱rīyo̱ madhu̍no̱ vi ra̍pśate ||
english: This radiance rises and is yoked; the wide-roaming chariot of this one is upon the ridge of heaven. Three pairs of nourishments rest within it; the fourth, a skin-bag of honey, pours forth.

sanskrit: ud vā̍m pṛ̱kṣāso̱ madhu̍manta īrate̱ rathā̱ aśvā̍sa u̱ṣaso̱ vyu̍ṣṭiṣu | a̱po̱rṇu̱vanta̱s tama̱ ā parī̍vṛta̱ṁ sva1̱̍r ṇa śu̱kraṁ ta̱nvanta̱ ā raja̍ḥ ||
english: The honey-rich nourishments, the chariots, the horses of Dawn rise up at her brightenings, uncovering the darkness that lay wrapped around, stretching forth the brilliant light like the sun through the atmosphere.

sanskrit: madhva̍ḥ pibatam madhu̱pebhi̍r ā̱sabhi̍r u̱ta pri̱yam madhu̍ne yuñjāthā̱ṁ ratha̍m | ā va̍rta̱nim madhu̍nā jinvathas pa̱tho dṛti̍ṁ vahethe̱ madhu̍mantam aśvinā ||
english: Drink of the honey with honey-drinking lips, O Aśvins, and yoke the dear chariot for honey's sake; quicken the road and the path with sweetness, carry the honey-full skin-bag, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: ha̱ṁsāso̱ ye vā̱m madhu̍manto a̱sridho̱ hira̍ṇyaparṇā u̱huva̍ uṣa̱rbudha̍ḥ | u̱da̱pruto̍ ma̱ndino̍ mandini̱spṛśo̱ madhvo̱ na makṣa̱ḥ sava̍nāni gacchathaḥ ||
english: Those swans of yours, honey-sweet, never stumbling, golden-winged, awaking at dawn — elate, delighting, touching those who delight — as bees to honey do you go to the pressings.

sanskrit: sva̱dhva̱rāso̱ madhu̍manto a̱gnaya̍ u̱srā ja̍rante̱ prati̱ vasto̍r a̱śvinā̍ | yan ni̱ktaha̍stas ta̱raṇi̍r vicakṣa̱ṇaḥ soma̍ṁ su̱ṣāva̱ madhu̍manta̱m adri̍bhiḥ ||
english: The sacrifice-worthy, honey-rich fires are lauded at each dawn for you, O Aśvins, when the fleet, far-seeing one with cleansed hands presses the honey-sweet Soma with the pressing stones.

sanskrit: ā̱ke̱ni̱pāso̱ aha̍bhi̱r davi̍dhvata̱ḥ sva1̱̍r ṇa śu̱kraṁ ta̱nvanta̱ ā raja̍ḥ ||
english: Drinking with bent necks, flashing day by day, they stretch the brilliant light through the atmosphere like the sun.

sanskrit: pra vā̍m avocam aśvinā dhiya̱ṁdhā ratha̱ḥ svaśvo̍ a̱jaro̱ yo asti̍ | yena̍ sa̱dyaḥ pari̱ rajā̍ṁsi yā̱tho ha̱viṣma̍ntaṁ ta̱raṇi̍m bho̱jam accha̍ ||
english: I have proclaimed to you, O Aśvins, thought-sustaining pair: yours is the chariot with good horses, unaging, with which you travel in a day around the realms, toward the swift, generous one who holds the offering.

sanskrit: agra̍m pibā̱ madhū̍nāṁ su̱taṁ vā̍yo̱ divi̍ṣṭiṣu | tvaṁ hi pū̍rva̱pā asi̍ ||
english: Drink first of the pressed juices of the honey-sweets at the heavenly strivings, O Vāyu, for you are the foremost drinker.

sanskrit: śa̱tenā̍ no a̱bhiṣṭi̍bhir ni̱yutvā̱m̐ indra̍sārathiḥ | vāyo̍ su̱tasya̍ tṛmpatam ||
english: With a hundredfold of conquests, with your team of horses, O Vāyu, with Indra as your charioteer, be satisfied with the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: ā vā̍ṁ sa̱hasra̱ṁ hara̍ya̱ indra̍vāyū a̱bhi praya̍ḥ | vaha̍ntu̱ soma̍pītaye ||
english: May a thousand bay horses carry you two, O Indra and Vāyu, toward the oblations, to drink of the Soma.

sanskrit: ratha̱ṁ hira̍ṇyavandhura̱m indra̍vāyū svadhva̱ram | ā hi sthātho̍ divi̱spṛśa̍m ||
english: Mount the chariot with the golden pole, O Indra and Vāyu, the well-sacrificed one that touches heaven.

sanskrit: rathe̍na pṛthu̱pāja̍sā dā̱śvāṁsa̱m upa̍ gacchatam | indra̍vāyū i̱hā ga̍tam ||
english: Come here, O Indra and Vāyu, to the worshipper with the chariot of broad brilliance; come hither.

sanskrit: indra̍vāyū a̱yaṁ su̱tas taṁ de̱vebhi̍ḥ sa̱joṣa̍sā | piba̍taṁ dā̱śuṣo̍ gṛ̱he ||
english: O Indra and Vāyu, this Soma is pressed; in the house of the worshipper, drink it together with the gods in harmony.

sanskrit: i̱ha pra̱yāṇa̍m astu vā̱m indra̍vāyū vi̱moca̍nam | i̱ha vā̱ṁ soma̍pītaye ||
english: Let your journeying and your unharnessing be here, O Indra and Vāyu; here be your drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: vāyo̍ śu̱kro a̍yāmi te̱ madhvo̱ agra̱ṁ divi̍ṣṭiṣu | ā yā̍hi̱ soma̍pītaye spā̱rho de̍va ni̱yutva̍tā ||
english: O Vāyu, bright is what I present to you, the first of the sweet juices at the heavenly strivings; come with your team of horses, O desirable god, to drink the Soma.

sanskrit: indra̍ś ca vāyav eṣā̱ṁ somā̍nām pī̱tim a̍rhathaḥ | yu̱vāṁ hi yantīnda̍vo ni̱mnam āpo̱ na sa̱dhrya̍k ||
english: Indra and Vāyu, you two deserve the drinking of these Soma juices; for the Indu drops flow toward you both together, as waters to a hollow.

sanskrit: vāya̱v indra̍ś ca śu̱ṣmiṇā̍ sa̱ratha̍ṁ śavasas patī | ni̱yutva̍ntā na ū̱taya̱ ā yā̍ta̱ṁ soma̍pītaye ||
english: O Vāyu and Indra, mighty lords of strength, together on one chariot with your teams, come to our aid, to drink the Soma.

sanskrit: yā vā̱ṁ santi̍ puru̱spṛho̍ ni̱yuto̍ dā̱śuṣe̍ narā | a̱sme tā ya̍jñavāha̱sendra̍vāyū̱ ni ya̍cchatam ||
english: Whatever much-coveted teams of horses you two have, O leaders, for the worshipper — bring those here to us, O Indra and Vāyu, bearers of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: vi̱hi hotrā̱ avī̍tā̱ vipo̱ na rāyo̍ a̱ryaḥ | vāya̱v ā ca̱ndreṇa̱ rathe̍na yā̱hi su̱tasya̍ pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Distribute the priestly portions undevoured, like the wealth of the noble man's poetic inspiration; O Vāyu, come with the shining chariot to drink the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: ni̱ryu̱vā̱ṇo aśa̍stīr ni̱yutvā̱m̐ indra̍sārathiḥ | vāya̱v ā ca̱ndreṇa̱ rathe̍na yā̱hi su̱tasya̍ pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Driving away ill words, with your team of horses, Indra as your charioteer — O Vāyu, come with the shining chariot to drink the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: anu̍ kṛ̱ṣṇe vasu̍dhitī ye̱māte̍ vi̱śvape̍śasā | vāya̱v ā ca̱ndreṇa̱ rathe̍na yā̱hi su̱tasya̍ pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Along the two dark, all-formed treasure-receivers they stretch; O Vāyu, come with the shining chariot to drink the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: vaha̍ntu tvā mano̱yujo̍ yu̱ktāso̍ nava̱tir nava̍ | vāya̱v ā ca̱ndreṇa̱ rathe̍na yā̱hi su̱tasya̍ pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Let the ninety-nine yoked, mind-swift steeds carry you; O Vāyu, come with the shining chariot to drink the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: vāyo̍ śa̱taṁ harī̍ṇāṁ yu̱vasva̱ poṣyā̍ṇām | u̱ta vā̍ te saha̱sriṇo̱ ratha̱ ā yā̍tu̱ pāja̍sā ||
english: O Vāyu, harness a hundred of your nourishing bay horses; or let your chariot come with a thousand, in full splendour.

sanskrit: i̱daṁ vā̍m ā̱sye̍ ha̱viḥ pri̱yam i̍ndrābṛhaspatī | u̱ktham mada̍ś ca śasyate ||
english: This dear oblation is placed in your mouths, O Indra and Bṛhaspati; the hymn of praise and the exhilaration are recited.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ vā̱m pari̍ ṣicyate̱ soma̍ indrābṛhaspatī | cāru̱r madā̍ya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: This Soma, dear and exhilarating, is poured around for you two, O Indra and Bṛhaspati, for drinking and for joy.

sanskrit: ā na̍ indrābṛhaspatī gṛ̱ham indra̍ś ca gacchatam | so̱ma̱pā soma̍pītaye ||
english: Come to our house, O Indra and Bṛhaspati — and you, Indra — O drinkers of Soma, to drink the Soma.

sanskrit: a̱sme i̍ndrābṛhaspatī ra̱yiṁ dha̍ttaṁ śata̱gvina̍m | aśvā̍vantaṁ saha̱sriṇa̍m ||
english: Bestow on us, O Indra and Bṛhaspati, wealth rich in hundreds of cattle, abounding in horses, in thousands.

sanskrit: indrā̱bṛha̱spatī̍ va̱yaṁ su̱te gī̱rbhir ha̍vāmahe | a̱sya soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: We invoke Indra and Bṛhaspati with songs when the Soma is pressed, to drink of this Soma.

sanskrit: soma̍m indrābṛhaspatī̱ piba̍taṁ dā̱śuṣo̍ gṛ̱he | mā̱daye̍thā̱ṁ tado̍kasā ||
english: Drink Soma, O Indra and Bṛhaspati, in the house of the worshipper; be exhilarated, you who have that as your home.

sanskrit: yas ta̱stambha̱ saha̍sā̱ vi jmo antā̱n bṛha̱spati̍s triṣadha̱stho rave̍ṇa | tam pra̱tnāsa̱ ṛṣa̍yo̱ dīdhyā̍nāḥ pu̱ro viprā̍ dadhire ma̱ndraji̍hvam ||
english: Bṛhaspati, who by his strength propped apart the ends of the earth, who has three seats and a roar — him the ancient seers, meditating, the inspired sages set at the fore, the one of the gladdening tongue.

sanskrit: dhu̱neta̍yaḥ suprake̱tam mada̍nto̱ bṛha̍spate a̱bhi ye na̍s tata̱sre | pṛṣa̍ntaṁ sṛ̱pram ada̍bdham ū̱rvam bṛha̍spate̱ rakṣa̍tād asya̱ yoni̍m ||
english: Those who roared, well-illumined, rejoicing, who have spread themselves against us, O Bṛhaspati — the dappled, gliding, undeceived, broad one: guard its birthplace, O Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit: bṛha̍spate̱ yā pa̍ra̱mā pa̍rā̱vad ata̱ ā ta̍ ṛta̱spṛśo̱ ni ṣe̍duḥ | tubhya̱ṁ khā̱tā a̍va̱tā adri̍dugdhā̱ madhva̍ḥ ścotanty a̱bhito̍ vira̱pśam ||
english: O Bṛhaspati, those who are in touch with truth have settled down from that farthest distance to here; the dug wells and pits milked from the rock drip honey on all sides of the mighty one.

sanskrit: bṛha̱spati̍ḥ pratha̱maṁ jāya̍māno ma̱ho jyoti̍ṣaḥ para̱me vyo̍man | sa̱ptāsya̍s tuvijā̱to rave̍ṇa̱ vi sa̱ptara̍śmir adhama̱t tamā̍ṁsi ||
english: Bṛhaspati, first born of great light in the highest heaven, seven-mouthed, born mightily with a roar, seven-rayed — he shattered the darknesses.

sanskrit: sa su̱ṣṭubhā̱ sa ṛkva̍tā ga̱ṇena̍ va̱laṁ ru̍roja phali̱gaṁ rave̍ṇa | bṛha̱spati̍r u̱sriyā̍ havya̱sūda̱ḥ kani̍krada̱d vāva̍śatī̱r ud ā̍jat ||
english: He, with the well-praising, hymn-singing troop, broke the Vala cave with his roar like a wedge; Bṛhaspati, the clarifier of the dawn cows, lowing and bellowing, drove them forth.

sanskrit: e̱vā pi̱tre vi̱śvade̍vāya̱ vṛṣṇe̍ ya̱jñair vi̍dhema̱ nama̍sā ha̱virbhi̍ḥ | bṛha̍spate supra̱jā vī̱rava̍nto va̱yaṁ syā̍ma̱ pata̍yo rayī̱ṇām ||
english: Thus do we honor the father, the bull Bṛhaspati, lord of all gods, with sacrifices, with homage and oblations; O Bṛhaspati, may we be with good offspring, rich in heroes, lords of riches.

sanskrit: sa id rājā̱ prati̍janyāni̱ viśvā̱ śuṣme̍ṇa tasthāv a̱bhi vī̱rye̍ṇa | bṛha̱spati̱ṁ yaḥ subhṛ̍tam bi̱bharti̍ valgū̱yati̱ vanda̍te pūrva̱bhāja̍m ||
english: He alone is king who stands with strength and heroism over all rivals; whoever bears Bṛhaspati well-supported, speaks sweetly and honors him as the first recipient.

sanskrit: sa it kṣe̍ti̱ sudhi̍ta̱ oka̍si̱ sve tasmā̱ iḻā̍ pinvate viśva̱dānī̍m | tasmai̱ viśa̍ḥ sva̱yam e̱vā na̍mante̱ yasmi̍n bra̱hmā rāja̍ni̱ pūrva̱ eti̍ ||
english: He alone dwells well-settled in his own house; Iḻā swells for him at all times; the clans bow of their own accord to that king in whom the brahman-priest walks first.

sanskrit: apra̍tīto jayati̱ saṁ dhanā̍ni̱ prati̍janyāny u̱ta yā saja̍nyā | a̱va̱syave̱ yo vari̍vaḥ kṛ̱ṇoti̍ bra̱hmaṇe̱ rājā̱ tam a̍vanti de̱vāḥ ||
english: Unresisted he wins all riches, those of rivals and those of kinsmen alike; the gods protect that king who creates largesse for the one seeking help, for the brahman-priest.

sanskrit: indra̍ś ca̱ soma̍m pibatam bṛhaspate̱ 'smin ya̱jñe ma̍ndasā̱nā vṛ̍ṣaṇvasū | ā vā̍ṁ viśa̱ntv inda̍vaḥ svā̱bhuvo̱ 'sme ra̱yiṁ sarva̍vīra̱ṁ ni ya̍cchatam ||
english: Drink Soma, O Indra and Bṛhaspati, exhilarated at this sacrifice, you bulls possessing good things; may the self-born Indu drops enter into you both; bestow on us wealth rich in all heroes.

sanskrit: bṛha̍spata indra̱ vardha̍taṁ na̱ḥ sacā̱ sā vā̍ṁ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme | a̱vi̱ṣṭaṁ dhiyo̍ jigṛ̱tam pura̍ṁdhīr jaja̱stam a̱ryo va̱nuṣā̱m arā̍tīḥ ||
english: O Bṛhaspati and Indra, increase us together; may your good favor be for us; be victorious, seize the thoughts, the inspirations; conquer the hostilities of those who hate the noble.

sanskrit: i̱dam u̱ tyat pu̍ru̱tama̍m pu̱rastā̱j jyoti̱s tama̍so va̱yunā̍vad asthāt | nū̱naṁ di̱vo du̍hi̱taro̍ vibhā̱tīr gā̱tuṁ kṛ̍ṇavann u̱ṣaso̱ janā̍ya ||
english: This most abundant light has now stood forth from the east out of darkness, possessed of knowledge; the daughters of Heaven, the Dawns, shining brightly, are now making a path for the people.

sanskrit: asthu̍r u ci̱trā u̱ṣasa̍ḥ pu̱rastā̍n mi̱tā i̍va̱ svara̍vo 'dhva̱reṣu̍ | vy ū̍ vra̱jasya̱ tama̍so̱ dvāro̱cchantī̍r avra̱ñ chuca̍yaḥ pāva̱kāḥ ||
english: The brilliant Dawns have also stood in the east, measured out like the resonating tones at the sacrifices; having opened the gates of the stall of darkness, shining and pure, they came forth.

sanskrit: u̱cchantī̍r a̱dya ci̍tayanta bho̱jān rā̍dho̱deyā̍yo̱ṣaso̍ ma̱ghonī̍ḥ | a̱ci̱tre a̱ntaḥ pa̱ṇaya̍ḥ sasa̱ntv abu̍dhyamānā̱s tama̍so̱ vima̍dhye ||
english: The bounty-giving, generous Dawns, as they shine today, awaken the benefactors; let the niggardly, unaware ones sleep in the midst of darkness, not awakening.

sanskrit: ku̱vit sa de̍vīḥ sa̱nayo̱ navo̍ vā̱ yāmo̍ babhū̱yād u̍ṣaso vo a̱dya | yenā̱ nava̍gve̱ aṅgi̍re̱ daśa̍gve sa̱ptāsye̍ revatī re̱vad ū̱ṣa ||
english: Might it be, O divine ones, an ancient or fresh journey of yours, O Dawns, today — that which shone richly for the nine-rayed Aṅgiras, the ten-rayed, and the seven-mouthed, O rich ones?

sanskrit: yū̱yaṁ hi de̍vīr ṛta̱yugbhi̱r aśvai̍ḥ pariprayā̱tha bhuva̍nāni sa̱dyaḥ | pra̱bo̱dhaya̍ntīr uṣasaḥ sa̱santa̍ṁ dvi̱pāc catu̍ṣpāc ca̱rathā̍ya jī̱vam ||
english: For you, O divine ones, with truth-yoked horses traverse all the worlds in an instant; the Dawns, awakening the sleeping one, stir into motion the living creature, bipedal and quadrupedal alike.

sanskrit: kva̍ svid āsāṁ kata̱mā pu̍rā̱ṇī yayā̍ vi̱dhānā̍ vida̱dhur ṛ̍bhū̱ṇām | śubha̱ṁ yac chu̱bhrā u̱ṣasa̱ś cara̍nti̱ na vi jñā̍yante sa̱dṛśī̍r aju̱ryāḥ ||
english: Where indeed is that ancient one of these by whose ordinance the Ṛbhus established their rule? As the bright Dawns move in beauty, they are not distinguished one from another, alike in form and undecaying.

sanskrit: tā ghā̱ tā bha̱drā u̱ṣasa̍ḥ pu̱rāsu̍r abhi̱ṣṭidyu̍mnā ṛ̱tajā̍tasatyāḥ | yāsv ī̍jā̱naḥ śa̍śamā̱na u̱kthaiḥ stu̱vañ chaṁsa̱n dravi̍ṇaṁ sa̱dya āpa̍ ||
english: Those indeed are auspicious Dawns of old, conquest-glorious, truth-born and true, in whose presence the sacrificer, who labored with hymns of praise, reciting and proclaiming, obtained wealth straightway.

sanskrit: tā ā ca̍ranti sama̱nā pu̱rastā̍t samā̱nata̍ḥ sama̱nā pa̍prathā̱nāḥ | ṛ̱tasya̍ de̱vīḥ sada̍so budhā̱nā gavā̱ṁ na sargā̍ u̱ṣaso̍ jarante ||
english: They move together from the east alike, spreading equally in the same way; the divine Dawns, awakening the seats of truth, stream forth like the release of cattle.

sanskrit: tā in nv e̱3̱̍va sa̍ma̱nā sa̍mā̱nīr amī̍tavarṇā u̱ṣasa̍ś caranti | gūha̍ntī̱r abhva̱m asi̍ta̱ṁ ruśa̍dbhiḥ śu̱krās ta̱nūbhi̱ḥ śuca̍yo rucā̱nāḥ ||
english: Thus indeed they go alike in the same manner, the Dawns of immeasurable color; with their bright bodies concealing the enormous dark thing, pure and luminous, they shine forth.

sanskrit: ra̱yiṁ di̍vo duhitaro vibhā̱tīḥ pra̱jāva̍ntaṁ yacchatā̱smāsu̍ devīḥ | syo̱nād ā va̍ḥ prati̱budhya̍mānāḥ su̱vīrya̍sya̱ pata̍yaḥ syāma ||
english: Grant us wealth rich in progeny, O daughters of Heaven shining brightly, O divine ones; awakening comfortably at your call, may we be lords of fine heroism.

sanskrit: tad vo̍ divo duhitaro vibhā̱tīr upa̍ bruva uṣaso ya̱jñake̍tuḥ | va̱yaṁ syā̍ma ya̱śaso̱ jane̍ṣu̱ tad dyauś ca̍ dha̱ttām pṛ̍thi̱vī ca̍ de̱vī ||
english: This I invoke of you, O daughters of Heaven shining brightly, O sacrifice-signaling Dawns; may we be among the famous among peoples — let Heaven and the divine Earth grant that.

sanskrit: prati̱ ṣyā sū̱narī̱ janī̍ vyu̱cchantī̱ pari̱ svasu̍ḥ | di̱vo a̍darśi duhi̱tā ||
english: Yonder kind and gracious woman, shining forth around her sister, is seen as the daughter of Heaven.

sanskrit: aśve̍va ci̱trāru̍ṣī mā̱tā gavā̍m ṛ̱tāva̍rī | sakhā̍bhūd a̱śvino̍r u̱ṣāḥ ||
english: Brilliant and ruddy like a horse, the mother of the cattle, possessing truth — Uṣas has become the companion of the Aśvins.

sanskrit: u̱ta sakhā̍sy a̱śvino̍r u̱ta mā̱tā gavā̍m asi | u̱toṣo̱ vasva̍ īśiṣe ||
english: And you are the companion of the Aśvins, and the mother of the cattle, and you, O Uṣas, rule over riches.

sanskrit: yā̱va̱yaddve̍ṣasaṁ tvā ciki̱tvit sū̍nṛtāvari | prati̱ stomai̍r abhutsmahi ||
english: You who are known as the driver-away of hatred, O possessor of sweet truth — we have met you with songs of praise.

sanskrit: prati̍ bha̱drā a̍dṛkṣata̱ gavā̱ṁ sargā̱ na ra̱śmaya̍ḥ | oṣā a̍prā u̱ru jraya̍ḥ ||
english: The auspicious ones were seen like the release of cattle, like rays of light; the Dawn filled the wide expanse.

sanskrit: ā̱pa̱pruṣī̍ vibhāvari̱ vy ā̍va̱r jyoti̍ṣā̱ tama̍ḥ | uṣo̱ anu̍ sva̱dhām a̍va ||
english: Filled with light, O brilliant one, you have opened wide the darkness with your luminosity; O Uṣas, shine forth according to your nature.

sanskrit: ā dyāṁ ta̍noṣi ra̱śmibhi̱r āntari̍kṣam u̱ru pri̱yam | uṣa̍ḥ śu̱kreṇa̍ śo̱ciṣā̍ ||
english: You stretch out the sky with your rays, and the wide, dear atmosphere, O Uṣas, with your bright flame.

sanskrit: tad de̱vasya̍ savi̱tur vārya̍m ma̱had vṛ̍ṇī̱mahe̱ asu̍rasya̱ prace̍tasaḥ | cha̱rdir yena̍ dā̱śuṣe̱ yaccha̍ti̱ tmanā̱ tan no̍ ma̱hām̐ ud a̍yān de̱vo a̱ktubhi̍ḥ ||
english: We choose that great desirable thing of divine Savitṛ, the mighty lord, endowed with foresight, whereby he spontaneously extends shelter to the worshipper; may the great god raise that up for us with his rays.

sanskrit: di̱vo dha̱rtā bhuva̍nasya pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ pi̱śaṅga̍ṁ drā̱pim prati̍ muñcate ka̱viḥ | vi̱ca̱kṣa̱ṇaḥ pra̱thaya̍nn āpṛ̱ṇann u̱rv ajī̍janat savi̱tā su̱mnam u̱kthya̍m ||
english: The supporter of heaven, the lord of creatures, the sage puts on his tawny robe; far-seeing, spreading and filling wide, Savitṛ has generated praiseworthy good cheer.

sanskrit: āprā̱ rajā̍ṁsi di̱vyāni̱ pārthi̍vā̱ śloka̍ṁ de̱vaḥ kṛ̍ṇute̱ svāya̱ dharma̍ṇe | pra bā̱hū a̍srāk savi̱tā savī̍mani nive̱śaya̍n prasu̱vann a̱ktubhi̱r jaga̍t ||
english: He filled the heavenly and earthly realms; the god makes his sound for his own sacred law; Savitṛ stretched out his arms at the impulsion, setting to rest and sending forth the world with his rays.

sanskrit: adā̍bhyo̱ bhuva̍nāni pra̱cāka̍śad vra̱tāni̍ de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tābhi ra̍kṣate | prāsrāg bā̱hū bhuva̍nasya pra̱jābhyo̍ dhṛ̱tavra̍to ma̱ho ajma̍sya rājati ||
english: Undeceivable, he illumines the worlds; the god Savitṛ protects the sacred laws; he stretched out his arms to the creatures of the world — he whose vow is firm rules over the great expanse.

sanskrit: trir a̱ntari̍kṣaṁ savi̱tā ma̍hitva̱nā trī rajā̍ṁsi pari̱bhus trīṇi̍ roca̱nā | ti̱sro diva̍ḥ pṛthi̱vīs ti̱sra i̍nvati tri̱bhir vra̱tair a̱bhi no̍ rakṣati̱ tmanā̍ ||
english: Savitṛ encompasses the atmosphere thrice in his greatness, three realms, and the three luminous regions; he invigorates the three earths and three heavens; with three sacred ordinances he protects us himself.

sanskrit: bṛ̱hatsu̍mnaḥ prasavī̱tā ni̱veśa̍no̱ jaga̍taḥ sthā̱tur u̱bhaya̍sya̱ yo va̱śī | sa no̍ de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā śarma̍ yacchatv a̱sme kṣayā̍ya tri̱varū̍tha̱m aṁha̍saḥ ||
english: He of great good cheer, the great impeller, the settler, who is the master of both the moving and the stationary world — may that god Savitṛ grant us shelter from distress, threefold protection for our dwelling.

sanskrit: āga̍n de̱va ṛ̱tubhi̱r vardha̍tu̱ kṣaya̱ṁ dadhā̍tu naḥ savi̱tā su̍pra̱jām iṣa̍m | sa na̍ḥ kṣa̱pābhi̱r aha̍bhiś ca jinvatu pra̱jāva̍ntaṁ ra̱yim a̱sme sam i̍nvatu ||
english: The god has come; may Savitṛ increase our dwelling with the seasons, establish for us nourishment with good progeny; may he quicken us through nights and days, and gather together for us wealth rich in progeny.

sanskrit: abhū̍d de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā vandyo̱ nu na̍ i̱dānī̱m ahna̍ upa̱vācyo̱ nṛbhi̍ḥ | vi yo ratnā̱ bhaja̍ti māna̱vebhya̱ḥ śreṣṭha̍ṁ no̱ atra̱ dravi̍ṇa̱ṁ yathā̱ dadha̍t ||
english: The divine Savitṛ has now become worthy of praise for us, to be invoked by men at this time of day; he who distributes treasures among mankind — may he place the best wealth here for us.

sanskrit: de̱vebhyo̱ hi pra̍tha̱maṁ ya̱jñiye̍bhyo 'mṛta̱tvaṁ su̱vasi̍ bhā̱gam u̍tta̱mam | ād id dā̱māna̍ṁ savita̱r vy ū̍rṇuṣe 'nūcī̱nā jī̍vi̱tā mānu̍ṣebhyaḥ ||
english: For first to the gods worthy of sacrifice you impel immortality as the highest portion; then, O Savitṛ, you unfold the gift — lives in succession to human beings.

sanskrit: aci̍ttī̱ yac ca̍kṛ̱mā daivye̱ jane̍ dī̱nair dakṣai̱ḥ prabhū̍tī pūruṣa̱tvatā̍ | de̱veṣu̍ ca savita̱r mānu̍ṣeṣu ca̱ tvaṁ no̱ atra̍ suvatā̱d anā̍gasaḥ ||
english: Whatever we have done inadvertently among the divine people, with feeble powers, through overabundance, or through human frailty — in regard to gods and to men, O Savitṛ, impel us here to sinlessness.

sanskrit: na pra̱miye̍ savi̱tur daivya̍sya̱ tad yathā̱ viśva̱m bhuva̍naṁ dhārayi̱ṣyati̍ | yat pṛ̍thi̱vyā vari̍ma̱nn ā sva̍ṅgu̱rir varṣma̍n di̱vaḥ su̱vati̍ sa̱tyam a̱sya tat ||
english: That of divine Savitṛ does not perish — namely that whereby he will hold up the entire world; what, in the breadth of earth, its beautiful-fingered one impels from the height of heaven — that is his truth.

sanskrit: indra̍jyeṣṭhān bṛ̱hadbhya̱ḥ parva̍tebhya̱ḥ kṣayā̍m̐ ebhyaḥ suvasi pa̱styā̍vataḥ | yathā̍-yathā pa̱taya̍nto viyemi̱ra e̱vaiva ta̍sthuḥ savitaḥ sa̱vāya̍ te ||
english: From the great mountains with Indra as their chief, you impel for these dwellings rich in homesteads; just as the flying ones spread out in various ways, so they have stood still for your impulsion, O Savitṛ.

sanskrit: ye te̱ trir aha̍n savitaḥ sa̱vāso̍ di̱ve-di̍ve̱ saubha̍gam āsu̱vanti̍ | indro̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī sindhu̍r a̱dbhir ā̍di̱tyair no̱ adi̍ti̱ḥ śarma̍ yaṁsat ||
english: May those three daily impulsions of yours, O Savitṛ, impel good fortune day by day; may Indra, Heaven and Earth, Sindhu with the waters, and Aditi with the Ādityas grant us shelter.

sanskrit: ko va̍s trā̱tā va̍sava̱ḥ ko va̍rū̱tā dyāvā̍bhūmī adite̱ trāsī̍thāṁ naḥ | sahī̍yaso varuṇa mitra̱ martā̱t ko vo̍ 'dhva̱re vari̍vo dhāti devāḥ ||
english: Who is your protector, O Vasus? Who your defender? O Heaven and Earth, O Aditi, protect us; O Varuṇa, O Mitra, who places wide space for you at the sacrifice from the mortal who is mightier, O gods?

sanskrit: pra ye dhāmā̍ni pū̱rvyāṇy arcā̱n vi yad u̱cchān vi̍yo̱tāro̱ amū̍rāḥ | vi̱dhā̱tāro̱ vi te da̍dhu̱r aja̍srā ṛ̱tadhī̍tayo rurucanta da̱smāḥ ||
english: Those who praise the ancient ordinances forth, when the wise separators separated and shone — the ordinators, the unwearied ones of truth-minded meditation, distributed them widely and shone, the wondrous ones.

sanskrit: pra pa̱styā̱3̱̍m adi̍ti̱ṁ sindhu̍m a̱rkaiḥ sva̱stim ī̍ḻe sa̱khyāya̍ de̱vīm | u̱bhe yathā̍ no̱ aha̍nī ni̱pāta̍ u̱ṣāsā̱naktā̍ karatā̱m ada̍bdhe ||
english: I praise with hymns Aditi, the homestead, Sindhu, the divine one, and Svasti for friendship; may the undeceiving Dawn and Night, both our days, be our protection.

sanskrit: vy a̍rya̱mā varu̍ṇaś ceti̱ panthā̍m i̱ṣas pati̍ḥ suvi̱taṁ gā̱tum a̱gniḥ | indrā̍viṣṇū nṛ̱vad u̱ ṣu stavā̍nā̱ śarma̍ no yanta̱m ama̍va̱d varū̍tham ||
english: Aryaman and Varuṇa mark out the path; Agni the lord of nourishment marks the easy way forward; Indra and Viṣṇu, praised with heroic hymns, lead us to shelter, a powerful protection.

sanskrit: ā parva̍tasya ma̱rutā̱m avā̍ṁsi de̱vasya̍ trā̱tur a̍vri̱ bhaga̍sya | pāt pati̱r janyā̱d aṁha̍so no mi̱tro mi̱triyā̍d u̱ta na̍ uruṣyet ||
english: May the aids of the mountain, of the Maruts, of the protecting god, of Bhaga come to us unchecked; may the lord protect us from the distress of birth; may Mitra deliver us from what belongs to Mitra.

sanskrit: nū ro̍dasī̱ ahi̍nā bu̱dhnye̍na stuvī̱ta de̍vī̱ apye̍bhir i̱ṣṭaiḥ | sa̱mu̱draṁ na sa̱ṁcara̍ṇe sani̱ṣyavo̍ gha̱rmasva̍raso na̱dyo̱3̱̍ apa̍ vran ||
english: Let the two divine world-halves be praised now with Ahī Budhnya, with the much-desired watery ones; as if converging to the sea, the rivers will sing out their praises, sweet-voiced with heat.

sanskrit: de̱vair no̍ de̱vy adi̍ti̱r ni pā̍tu de̱vas trā̱tā trā̍yatā̱m apra̍yucchan | na̱hi mi̱trasya̱ varu̍ṇasya dhā̱sim arhā̍masi pra̱miya̱ṁ sānv a̱gneḥ ||
english: May divine Aditi protect us along with the gods; may the god the protector guard us without faltering; for we do not deserve the violation of Mitra's and Varuṇa's foundation, nor the destruction of Agni's summit.

sanskrit: a̱gnir ī̍śe vasa̱vya̍syā̱gnir ma̱haḥ saubha̍gasya | tāny a̱smabhya̍ṁ rāsate ||
english: Agni rules over wealth in cattle, Agni over great good fortune; may he grant these to us.

sanskrit: uṣo̍ magho̱ny ā va̍ha̱ sūnṛ̍te̱ vāryā̍ pu̱ru | a̱smabhya̍ṁ vājinīvati ||
english: O bountiful Uṣas, O possessor of sweet truth, bring the many desirable things to us, O you rich in prize-winning strength.

sanskrit: tat su na̍ḥ savi̱tā bhago̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā | indro̍ no̱ rādha̱sā ga̍mat ||
english: May Savitṛ, Bhaga, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman bring that to us; may Indra come to us with bounty.

sanskrit: ma̱hī dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī i̱ha jyeṣṭhe̍ ru̱cā bha̍vatāṁ śu̱caya̍dbhir a̱rkaiḥ | yat sī̱ṁ vari̍ṣṭhe bṛha̱tī vi̍mi̱nvan ru̱vad dho̱kṣā pa̍prathā̱nebhi̱r evai̍ḥ ||
english: Let the two great ones, Heaven and Earth, be here supreme in splendor with their purifying hymns; when the young bull bellows in the highest and greatest expanse, marking it out, he has spread it with his paths.

sanskrit: de̱vī de̱vebhi̍r yaja̱te yaja̍trai̱r ami̍natī tasthatur u̱kṣamā̍ṇe | ṛ̱tāva̍rī a̱druhā̍ de̱vapu̍tre ya̱jñasya̍ ne̱trī śu̱caya̍dbhir a̱rkaiḥ ||
english: The two divine ones worship with the gods worthy of worship, inviolate, standing firm while being sprinkled; possessing truth, without treachery, divine daughters — the leaders of the sacrifice with purifying hymns.

sanskrit: sa it svapā̱ bhuva̍neṣv āsa̱ ya i̱me dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī ja̱jāna̍ | u̱rvī ga̍bhī̱re raja̍sī su̱meke̍ ava̱ṁśe dhīra̱ḥ śacyā̱ sam ai̍rat ||
english: He was indeed the good worker among the worlds who generated these two — Heaven and Earth; the wise one skillfully set in order the two wide, deep, well-formed realms in the stalkless.

sanskrit: nū ro̍dasī bṛ̱hadbhi̍r no̱ varū̍thai̱ḥ patnī̍vadbhir i̱ṣaya̍ntī sa̱joṣā̍ḥ | u̱rū̱cī viśve̍ yaja̱te ni pā̍taṁ dhi̱yā syā̍ma ra̱thya̍ḥ sadā̱sāḥ ||
english: Now let the two world-halves protect us with their great shelters together with their consorts, energizing, of one accord; vast and worshipped by all the gods, may we be seated in your protection, chariot-masters, ever gaining.

sanskrit: pra vā̱m mahi̱ dyavī̍ a̱bhy upa̍stutim bharāmahe | śucī̱ upa̱ praśa̍staye ||
english: We bring forth to you two mighty ones — Heaven and Earth — a great laudation for your praise, you two pure ones.

sanskrit: pu̱nā̱ne ta̱nvā̍ mi̱thaḥ svena̱ dakṣe̍ṇa rājathaḥ | ū̱hyāthe̍ sa̱nād ṛ̱tam ||
english: Purifying each other with one's own body, you rule with your own wisdom; you carry truth from of old.

sanskrit: ma̱hī mi̱trasya̍ sādhatha̱s tara̍ntī̱ pipra̍tī ṛ̱tam | pari̍ ya̱jñaṁ ni ṣe̍dathuḥ ||
english: You two mighty ones further the work of Mitra, crossing and filling truth; you have settled around the sacrifice.

sanskrit: kṣetra̍sya̱ pati̍nā va̱yaṁ hi̱tene̍va jayāmasi | gām aśva̍m poṣayi̱tnv ā sa no̍ mṛḻātī̱dṛśe̍ ||
english: We win through the lord of the field as if through a friend; may he who fattens the cattle and horse be gracious to us to such an end.

sanskrit: kṣetra̍sya pate̱ madhu̍mantam ū̱rmiṁ dhe̱nur i̍va̱ payo̍ a̱smāsu̍ dhukṣva | ma̱dhu̱ścuta̍ṁ ghṛ̱tam i̍va̱ supū̍tam ṛ̱tasya̍ na̱ḥ pata̍yo mṛḻayantu ||
english: O lord of the field, milk the honey-sweet wave for us as a milch cow gives milk; may the lords of truth be gracious to us, dripping sweetness like well-purified ghee.

sanskrit: madhu̍matī̱r oṣa̍dhī̱r dyāva̱ āpo̱ madhu̍man no bhavatv a̱ntari̍kṣam | kṣetra̍sya̱ pati̱r madhu̍mān no a̱stv ari̍ṣyanto̱ anv e̍naṁ carema ||
english: Honey-sweet be the plants, sweet the sky, sweet the waters; sweet to us be the atmosphere; sweet to us be the lord of the field — may we follow after him unharmed.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ vā̱hāḥ śu̱naṁ nara̍ḥ śu̱naṁ kṛ̍ṣatu̱ lāṅga̍lam | śu̱naṁ va̍ra̱trā ba̍dhyantāṁ śu̱nam aṣṭrā̱m ud i̍ṅgaya ||
english: May the draught beasts go happily, happily the men, may the plow furrow happily; may the harness be bound happily; raise the goad happily.

sanskrit: śunā̍sīrāv i̱māṁ vāca̍ṁ juṣethā̱ṁ yad di̱vi ca̱krathu̱ḥ paya̍ḥ | tene̱mām upa̍ siñcatam ||
english: O Śunā and Sīrā, be pleased with this word; whatever milk you two have created in heaven — with that sprinkle this earth here.

sanskrit: a̱rvācī̍ subhage bhava̱ sīte̱ vandā̍mahe tvā | yathā̍ naḥ su̱bhagāsa̍si̱ yathā̍ naḥ su̱phalāsa̍si ||
english: Come toward us, O lucky furrow, O Sītā — we reverence you; be favorable to us, be fruitful to us.

sanskrit: indra̱ḥ sītā̱ṁ ni gṛ̍hṇātu̱ tām pū̱ṣānu̍ yacchatu | sā na̱ḥ paya̍svatī duhā̱m utta̍rām-uttarā̱ṁ samā̍m ||
english: May Indra hold the furrow; may Pūṣan follow after it; may it, rich in milk, yield for us year after ever more abundant year.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ na̱ḥ phālā̱ vi kṛ̍ṣantu̱ bhūmi̍ṁ śu̱naṁ kī̱nāśā̍ a̱bhi ya̍ntu vā̱haiḥ | śu̱nam pa̱rjanyo̱ madhu̍nā̱ payo̍bhi̱ḥ śunā̍sīrā śu̱nam a̱smāsu̍ dhattam ||
english: May the plowshares happily plow the earth for us; may the plowmen happily proceed with their draught beasts; may Parjanya happily water with honey and milk; may Śunā and Sīrā bestow happiness on us.

sanskrit: sa̱mu̱drād ū̱rmir madhu̍mā̱m̐ ud ā̍ra̱d upā̱ṁśunā̱ sam a̍mṛta̱tvam ā̍naṭ | ghṛ̱tasya̱ nāma̱ guhya̱ṁ yad asti̍ ji̱hvā de̱vānā̍m a̱mṛta̍sya̱ nābhi̍ḥ ||
english: From the ocean the honey-sweet wave rose up and has secretly come into contact with immortality; this is the hidden name of Ghee — the tongue of the gods, the navel of immortality.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ nāma̱ pra bra̍vāmā ghṛ̱tasyā̱smin ya̱jñe dhā̍rayāmā̱ namo̍bhiḥ | upa̍ bra̱hmā śṛ̍ṇavac cha̱syamā̍na̱ṁ catu̍ḥśṛṅgo 'vamīd gau̱ra e̱tat ||
english: We proclaim the name of Ghee; we uphold it at this sacrifice with reverences; may the brahman-priest hear it as it is recited — the tawny wild bull bellowed with his four horns.

sanskrit: ca̱tvāri̱ śṛṅgā̱ trayo̍ asya̱ pādā̱ dve śī̱rṣe sa̱pta hastā̍so asya | tridhā̍ ba̱ddho vṛ̍ṣa̱bho ro̍ravīti ma̱ho de̱vo martyā̱m̐ ā vi̍veśa ||
english: Four are its horns, three its feet, two its heads, seven its hands — the bull bound in three ways bellows; the great god has entered into mortals.

sanskrit: tridhā̍ hi̱tam pa̱ṇibhi̍r gu̱hyamā̍na̱ṁ gavi̍ de̱vāso̍ ghṛ̱tam anv a̍vindan | indra̱ eka̱ṁ sūrya̱ eka̍ṁ jajāna ve̱nād eka̍ṁ sva̱dhayā̱ niṣ ṭa̍takṣuḥ ||
english: Hidden in three ways by the Paṇis, the gods found the ghee within the cow; Indra produced one portion, the Sun another, and from Vena they fashioned a third by their own power.

sanskrit: e̱tā a̍rṣanti̱ hṛdyā̍t samu̱drāc cha̱tavra̍jā ri̱puṇā̱ nāva̱cakṣe̍ | ghṛ̱tasya̱ dhārā̍ a̱bhi cā̍kaśīmi hira̱ṇyayo̍ veta̱so madhya̍ āsām ||
english: These flow from the heart, from the ocean of a hundred enclosures — unseen by the enemy; I behold the streams of ghee; in the midst of them stands a golden reed.

sanskrit: sa̱myak sra̍vanti sa̱rito̱ na dhenā̍ a̱ntar hṛ̱dā mana̍sā pū̱yamā̍nāḥ | e̱te a̍rṣanty ū̱rmayo̍ ghṛ̱tasya̍ mṛ̱gā i̍va kṣipa̱ṇor īṣa̍māṇāḥ ||
english: They flow together like rivers, like milch cows, purified within the heart and mind; the waves of ghee rush forth like deer before the bow.

sanskrit: sindho̍r iva prādhva̱ne śū̍gha̱nāso̱ vāta̍pramiyaḥ patayanti ya̱hvāḥ | ghṛ̱tasya̱ dhārā̍ aru̱ṣo na vā̱jī kāṣṭhā̍ bhi̱ndann ū̱rmibhi̱ḥ pinva̍mānaḥ ||
english: Like the roar before a river's current, the young, wind-swift ones fly; the stream of ghee, like a ruddy prize horse cleaving the winning post with its waves, swells and surges.

sanskrit: a̱bhi pra̍vanta̱ sama̍neva̱ yoṣā̍ḥ kalyā̱ṇya1̱̍ḥ smaya̍mānāso a̱gnim | ghṛ̱tasya̱ dhārā̍ḥ sa̱midho̍ nasanta̱ tā ju̍ṣā̱ṇo ha̍ryati jā̱tave̍dāḥ ||
english: They flow toward him like auspicious, smiling women toward the same man — toward Agni; the streams of ghee, the kindlings, come together — Jātavedas delights in them with joy.

sanskrit: ka̱nyā̍ iva vaha̱tum eta̱vā u̍ a̱ñjy a̍ñjā̱nā a̱bhi cā̍kaśīmi | yatra̱ soma̍ḥ sū̱yate̱ yatra̍ ya̱jño ghṛ̱tasya̱ dhārā̍ a̱bhi tat pa̍vante ||
english: I behold the adorned ones, anointing themselves as if maidens going to a wedding; where Soma is pressed, where the sacrifice takes place, the streams of ghee purify that place.

sanskrit: a̱bhy a̍rṣata suṣṭu̱tiṁ gavya̍m ā̱jim a̱smāsu̍ bha̱drā dravi̍ṇāni dhatta | i̱maṁ ya̱jñaṁ na̍yata de̱vatā̍ no ghṛ̱tasya̱ dhārā̱ madhu̍mat pavante ||
english: Flow toward the excellent praise, the contest of cows; bestow on us auspicious riches; guide this sacrifice of ours, O gods — the honey-sweet streams of ghee purify it.

sanskrit: dhāma̍n te̱ viśva̱m bhuva̍na̱m adhi̍ śri̱tam a̱ntaḥ sa̍mu̱dre hṛ̱dy a1̱̍ntar āyu̍ṣi | a̱pām anī̍ke sami̱the ya ābhṛ̍ta̱s tam a̍śyāma̱ madhu̍mantaṁ ta ū̱rmim ||
english: In your station all the world rests — within the ocean, within the heart, within life; that which is brought together at the face of the waters, at the confluence — may we attain that honey-sweet wave of yours.
